page.title: 理由の後ろが文か名詞か

analysis.summaryJa: 理由表現は後続要素の形で選ぶ。becauseの後ろには主語と動詞を備えた節、because of・due to・owing to・thanks to・on account ofの後ろには名詞句または動名詞句が続く。due toとowing toは改まった原因説明、thanks toは通常好ましい原因、on account ofは問題事情を丁寧に示す。
grammarPoints: due to / owing toによるフォーマルな原因説明
thanks toによる好ましい原因の提示
on account ofによる問題事情の提示
節と名詞句の相互言い換え
visualEvidence: マスコットがCLAUSEとNOUNのカードを持ち後続形を分類している
表がbecauseとbecause of系の後ろの構造を対比している
凍結道路の例がbecause節とbecause of名詞句の言い換えを矢印で示す
ミニ練習がbecause ofの後ろに節を置く誤りを訂正している
commonTraps: because ofの後ろに主語＋動詞の節を直接置く
becauseの後ろを名詞句だけにする
thanks toを中立または悪い原因に無自覚に使う
due toのtoを不定詞と誤解して動詞原形を置く

questions.prompt: The morning flight was canceled ------- dense fog near the airport.

choices.A: because
choices.B: although
choices.C: because of
choices.D: unless

questions.translationJa: 空港付近の濃霧のため、朝の便は欠航になりました。
questions.explanationJa: 空所の後ろは名詞句dense fogなのでbecause ofが適切です。

questions.prompt: The product launch was delayed ------- a supplier failed to deliver the packaging on time.

choices.A: because
choices.B: because of
choices.C: due to
choices.D: thanks to

questions.translationJa: 供給業者が包装材を期限どおり納品しなかったため、製品発売は延期されました。
questions.explanationJa: 後ろに主語a supplierと動詞failedがあるためbecauseを使います。

questions.prompt: The conference room is unavailable ------- an unexpected electrical problem.

choices.A: because
choices.B: so that
choices.C: even though
choices.D: due to

questions.translationJa: 予期しない電気系統の問題により、会議室は利用できません。
questions.explanationJa: 名詞句を伴う改まった原因説明にはdue toが自然です。

questions.prompt: ------- the updated navigation system, our drivers reduced their average delivery time.

choices.A: Because
choices.B: Thanks to
choices.C: Although
choices.D: Unless

questions.translationJa: 更新されたナビゲーションシステムのおかげで、運転手の平均配送時間が短くなりました。
questions.explanationJa: 好ましい結果をもたらした名詞句の原因なのでThanks toが適切です。

questions.prompt: The inspection was postponed ------- the chief engineer being absent.

choices.A: owing to
choices.B: because
choices.C: whereas
choices.D: in order to

questions.translationJa: 主任技師が不在だったため、検査は延期されました。
questions.explanationJa: 動名詞句the chief engineer being absentを受ける正式なowing toが適切です。

questions.prompt: The north entrance is temporarily closed ------- repairs to the revolving door.

choices.A: because
choices.B: provided that
choices.C: on account of
choices.D: as soon as

questions.translationJa: 回転ドアの修理のため、北口は一時閉鎖されています。
questions.explanationJa: 問題事情を示す名詞句repairsを受けるon account ofが適切です。

questions.prompt: The sales team exceeded its target ------- demand increased sharply in July.

choices.A: because of
choices.B: because
choices.C: despite
choices.D: thanks to

questions.translationJa: 7月に需要が急増したため、営業チームは目標を上回りました。
questions.explanationJa: 後ろが主語＋動詞の完全な節なのでbecauseが唯一正しい形です。

questions.prompt: The outdoor concert ended early ------- strong winds and heavy rain.

choices.A: because
choices.B: while
choices.C: so that
choices.D: because of

questions.translationJa: 強風と大雨のため、屋外コンサートは早く終了しました。
questions.explanationJa: strong winds and heavy rainは名詞句なのでbecause ofを用います。

questions.prompt: ------- your detailed instructions, we installed the equipment without assistance.

choices.A: Thanks to
choices.B: Because
choices.C: In spite
choices.D: Until

questions.translationJa: 詳しい説明のおかげで、私たちは支援なしで機器を設置できました。
questions.explanationJa: 有益な原因である名詞句your detailed instructionsにはThanks toが合います。

questions.prompt: The store reduced its hours ------- a shortage of trained staff.

choices.A: because
choices.B: due to
choices.C: even if
choices.D: so as to

questions.translationJa: 訓練を受けた人員の不足により、店舗は営業時間を短縮しました。
questions.explanationJa: a shortageは名詞句で、公的な原因説明なのでdue toが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with the correct structure after “because”.

choices.A: The tour was canceled because the guide’s illness.
choices.B: The tour was canceled because of the guide was ill.
choices.C: The tour was canceled because of was the guide ill.
choices.D: The tour was canceled because the guide was ill.

questions.translationJa: 案内人が病気だったため、ツアーは中止されました。
questions.explanationJa: becauseの後に主語the guideと動詞wasを含む節が続いています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with the correct structure after “because of”.

choices.A: The delivery was delayed because road construction.
choices.B: The delivery was delayed because of road construction.
choices.C: The delivery was delayed because of the road was under construction.
choices.D: Because of the road was under construction, delayed the delivery.

questions.translationJa: 道路工事のため、配送は遅れました。
questions.explanationJa: because ofの後ろに名詞句road constructionを置く形が正しいです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly uses “due to”.

choices.A: The clinic closed early due to the water supply failed.
choices.B: The clinic closed early due to repair the water supply.
choices.C: The clinic closed early due to a water supply problem.
choices.D: Due the water supply problem, the clinic closed early.

questions.translationJa: 給水の問題により、診療所は早く閉まりました。
questions.explanationJa: due toの後ろに名詞句a water supply problemが続く正しい構造です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that naturally uses “thanks to”.

choices.A: Thanks to the receptionist’s quick response, the customer recovered her lost bag.
choices.B: Thanks the receptionist responded quickly, the customer recovered her lost bag.
choices.C: Because of the receptionist responded quickly, the customer recovered her lost bag.
choices.D: Thanks to the bag was lost, the receptionist responded quickly.

questions.translationJa: 受付係の素早い対応のおかげで、顧客は紛失したバッグを取り戻しました。
questions.explanationJa: 好ましい結果の原因となる名詞句をThanks toが自然に導いています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly converts the reason clause to a noun phrase.

choices.A: The meeting was moved because the director’s late arrival.
choices.B: The meeting was moved because of the director arrived late.
choices.C: The meeting was moved due the director’s late arrival.
choices.D: The meeting was moved because of the director’s late arrival.

questions.translationJa: 取締役の到着が遅れたため、会議は変更されました。
questions.explanationJa: because the director arrived lateをbecause of＋名詞句に正しく変換しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly uses “owing to”.

choices.A: Owing to the equipment is being tested, the studio will remain closed.
choices.B: Owing the equipment being tested, the studio will remain closed.
choices.C: Owing to equipment being tested, the studio will remain closed.
choices.D: Owing to test the equipment, the studio will remain closed.

questions.translationJa: 機器の試験中のため、スタジオは閉鎖されたままです。
questions.explanationJa: owing toの後ろには名詞相当のequipment being testedが続きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly uses “on account of”.

choices.A: Several trains were delayed on account a signal failure.
choices.B: Several trains were delayed on account of a signal failure.
choices.C: Several trains were delayed on account of a signal failed.
choices.D: On account of the signal failed several trains because delayed.

questions.translationJa: 信号故障のため、数本の列車が遅れました。
questions.explanationJa: on account ofの後に名詞句a signal failureを置いた正しい文です。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct reason expression.

choices.A: Because of the parking lot is full, guests should use the east garage.
choices.B: Due to the parking lot is full, guests should use the east garage.
choices.C: Owing to the parking lot is full, guests should use the east garage.
choices.D: Because the parking lot is full, guests should use the east garage.

questions.translationJa: 駐車場が満車なので、来客は東側駐車棟を利用してください。
questions.explanationJa: 後ろが完全な節the parking lot is fullなのでbecauseだけが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with a correct formal cause phrase.

choices.A: The ceremony was relocated due to the weather conditions were unfavorable.
choices.B: The ceremony was relocated because of were unfavorable weather conditions.
choices.C: The ceremony was relocated due to unfavorable weather conditions.
choices.D: Due unfavorable weather conditions, the ceremony relocated because.

questions.translationJa: 悪天候により、式典は場所を移して行われました。
questions.explanationJa: due toの後に名詞句unfavorable weather conditionsが続いています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly expresses a beneficial cause.

choices.A: Thanks to lower shipping costs, the company can offer free delivery.
choices.B: Thanks to shipping costs are lower, the company can offer free delivery.
choices.C: Because lower shipping costs, the company can offer free delivery.
choices.D: Thanks lower shipping costs, the company can offer free delivery.

questions.translationJa: 配送費が下がったおかげで、会社は無料配送を提供できます。
questions.explanationJa: Thanks toは好結果につながる名詞句lower shipping costsを受けています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The event was canceled because the venue lost power.”

choices.A: The event was canceled because of a power outage at the venue.
choices.B: The venue lost power after the event proceeded as planned.
choices.C: The event was held in order to restore power to the venue.
choices.D: Despite a power outage, the event was not canceled.

questions.translationJa: 会場の停電のため、イベントは中止されました。
questions.explanationJa: because節をbecause of＋名詞句a power outageに変えて同じ原因を表しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The road closed because of flooding.”

choices.A: The road remained open despite severe flooding.
choices.B: The road closed so that the area would flood.
choices.C: Flooding began because the road reopened.
choices.D: The road closed because the area was flooded.

questions.translationJa: その地域が浸水したため、道路は閉鎖されました。
questions.explanationJa: because of floodingをbecause＋節に展開して同じ因果を表しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Thanks to Aya’s directions, we arrived on time.”

choices.A: We arrived late because Aya did not give directions.
choices.B: Aya asked for directions after we reached the destination.
choices.C: Aya’s directions helped us reach our destination punctually.
choices.D: Although Aya’s directions were unclear, we missed the appointment.

questions.translationJa: アヤの道案内のおかげで、私たちは時間どおり目的地に着きました。
questions.explanationJa: Thanks toが示す好ましい原因をhelpedで自然に言い換えています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The inspection was delayed due to a staffing shortage.”

choices.A: The inspection solved the shortage by hiring additional staff.
choices.B: A shortage of staff caused the inspection to be delayed.
choices.C: The inspection proceeded early although no staff were available.
choices.D: Staffing increased because the delayed inspection had ended.

questions.translationJa: 人員不足が検査の遅延を引き起こしました。
questions.explanationJa: due to以下の原因を主語にしてcauseで表した同義文です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We stayed inside because it was extremely hot.”

choices.A: We stayed inside because of the extreme heat.
choices.B: We went outside despite the extreme heat.
choices.C: We stayed inside so that the temperature would rise.
choices.D: The indoor temperature became hot after we left.

questions.translationJa: 猛暑のため、私たちは屋内にいました。
questions.explanationJa: because＋節をbecause of＋名詞句に正しく変換しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Owing to a software error, some invoices were duplicated.”

choices.A: The duplicated invoices corrected the software error.
choices.B: The software worked correctly despite duplicate invoices.
choices.C: Some invoices were duplicated because the software contained an error.
choices.D: Invoices were duplicated in order to test the software.

questions.translationJa: ソフトウェアにエラーがあったため、一部の請求書が重複しました。
questions.explanationJa: owing to＋名詞句の原因をbecause＋節で表した同義文です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The picnic was moved indoors on account of the wind.”

choices.A: The indoor picnic caused strong winds outdoors.
choices.B: The picnic remained outdoors although the wind was strong.
choices.C: The wind stopped because the picnic moved outside.
choices.D: The wind was the reason the picnic was moved inside.

questions.translationJa: 風が、ピクニックを屋内へ移した理由でした。
questions.explanationJa: on account ofは問題となる原因を示し、the reasonで同じ関係を表せます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Because the printer malfunctioned, the reports were sent electronically.”

choices.A: The reports were emailed because of a problem with the printer.
choices.B: The printer malfunctioned after paper reports were delivered.
choices.C: Electronic reports caused the printer to work normally.
choices.D: The reports were printed despite being sent electronically.

questions.translationJa: プリンターの問題のため、報告書は電子メールで送られました。
questions.explanationJa: because節をbecause of＋名詞句にして同じ原因と結果を保っています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Thanks to the new checklist, errors have decreased.”

choices.A: The checklist was removed because errors had decreased.
choices.B: The new checklist has helped reduce the number of errors.
choices.C: Errors increased despite the use of a new checklist.
choices.D: The new checklist resulted from a rise in errors only.

questions.translationJa: 新しいチェックリストが、誤りの減少に役立ちました。
questions.explanationJa: thanks toが表す有益な原因をhelped reduceで言い換えています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The ferry service stopped due to rough seas.”

choices.A: The rough sea became calm after the ferry continued operating.
choices.B: The ferry operated so that the sea would become rough.
choices.C: The ferry stopped operating because the sea was rough.
choices.D: Despite calm conditions, the ferry service was expanded.

questions.translationJa: 海が荒れていたため、フェリーは運航を停止しました。
questions.explanationJa: due to＋名詞句をbecause＋節へ展開した同義文です。

questions.prompt: The customer could not log in ------- her password had expired. A technician helped her reset it.

choices.A: because of
choices.B: because
choices.C: due to
choices.D: thanks to

questions.translationJa: パスワードの有効期限が切れていたため、顧客はログインできませんでした。技術者が再設定を手伝いました。
questions.explanationJa: 空所後が主語her passwordと動詞had expiredを含む節なのでbecauseです。

questions.prompt: The entrance ramp is closed ------- repairs. Wheelchair users should enter through the south lobby.

choices.A: because
choices.B: although
choices.C: so that
choices.D: because of

questions.explanationJa: 空所後のrepairsは名詞なのでbecause ofが適切です。

questions.prompt: ------- the online reservation system was unavailable, the hotel accepted bookings by phone.

choices.A: Because
choices.B: Because of
choices.C: Due to
choices.D: Thanks to

questions.translationJa: オンライン予約システムが利用できなかったため、ホテルは電話で予約を受け付けました。
questions.explanationJa: 後ろが主語と動詞の節なのでBecauseが唯一文法的です。

questions.prompt: Production increased by twelve percent ------- the installation of faster assembly equipment.

choices.A: because
choices.B: unless
choices.C: thanks to
choices.D: even though

questions.translationJa: より高速な組立設備を導入したおかげで、生産量は12パーセント増えました。
questions.explanationJa: 好ましい結果の原因となる名詞句にはthanks toが自然です。

questions.prompt: Today’s harbor tour has been suspended ------- high waves. Ticket holders will receive refunds.

choices.A: because

choices.C: so that
choices.D: due to

questions.explanationJa: 公的な案内で名詞句high wavesを受けるdue toが適切です。

questions.prompt: The team finished the audit early ------- every department submitted its records on time.

choices.A: because of
choices.B: because
choices.C: owing to
choices.D: despite

questions.translationJa: 全部門が期限どおり記録を提出したため、チームは監査を早く終えました。
questions.explanationJa: 空所後は完全な節なのでbecauseを選びます。

questions.prompt: The loading area is congested ------- several trucks arriving at the same time.

choices.A: because of
choices.B: because
choices.C: unless
choices.D: whereas

questions.translationJa: 数台のトラックが同時に到着したため、積み込み区域が混雑しています。
questions.explanationJa: several trucks arrivingは動名詞を含む名詞相当句なのでbecause ofです。

questions.prompt: The award ceremony began late ------- a problem with the sound system.

choices.A: because
choices.B: in order that
choices.C: as soon as
choices.D: on account of

questions.explanationJa: 問題となった名詞句を丁寧に示すon account ofが文脈に合います。

questions.prompt: ------- your prompt reply, we were able to confirm the reservation before the deadline.

choices.A: Because
choices.B: Until
choices.C: Thanks to
choices.D: Despite

questions.explanationJa: 有益な原因である名詞句your prompt replyを受けるThanks toが適切です。

questions.prompt: The warehouse was evacuated ------- smoke had been detected near the charging station.

choices.A: because of
choices.B: because
choices.C: due to
choices.D: thanks to

questions.translationJa: 充電所付近で煙が検知されたため、倉庫から避難しました。
questions.explanationJa: 空所後に主語smokeと動詞had been detectedがあるためbecauseです。
